title: Red-team
description: Adversarial robustness testing — only against your own registered and authorized agents. The API carries defensive taxonomy and scorecards, never an attack payload.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: The consent surface. A run only ever touches an agent you have registered and authorized.
targets.consentNote: Registering an agent is not consent. A target is born non-authorized — authorize it to grant consent, and revoke at any time.
targets.emptyHint: Register one of your own agents as a candidate, then authorize it to run probes.

dialog.registerHint: Register one of your own agents as a red-team candidate.
dialog.notConsentNote: Registering is not consent — the candidate is created non-authorized and no run can touch it until you authorize it.
dialog.name: Display name
dialog.authorizeHint: Granting consent lets red-team runs probe {{name}}. This action is recorded in the audit ledger.
dialog.revokeHint: Revoking consent stops any further runs against {{name}}. This action is recorded in the audit ledger.

targets.truncatedHint: There are more registered targets than shown; this page takes rows by id. A target missing from this list does not demonstrate that it is unregistered or unauthorized — it may simply be beyond this page.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Each run probes an authorized target and produces a robustness scorecard. Failed probes become findings.
runs.launchGatedHint: Launch is disabled until this target is authorized — registering an agent is not consent.
runs.degradedHint: All probes were skipped — no sandbox was available. This is pending sandbox, not a pass.
runs.errorHint: All probes failed by execution error. This is not a robustness verdict; re-run once the issue is resolved.
runs.emptyHint: Launch a run against an authorized target to produce a scorecard.

scorecard.title: Scorecard
scorecard.description: Robustness = passed / (passed + failed) × 100. Errors and skipped probes are excluded; higher is better.

byFamily.title: Failures by family
byFamily.description: Probe families with at least one failed probe.
byFamily.summary: Failures by family, {{count}} families with failures, worst is {{family}} with {{failed}} failed probes.
byFamily.summaryEmpty: No probe family had any failures.

owasp.title: OWASP failures
owasp.description: OWASP rows with a failed probe (count by reference).

dialog.title: Launch run
dialog.hint: Probe {{name}} with the selected suite. This adversarial action is recorded in the audit ledger.

runs.truncatedHint: There are more runs than shown; this page takes rows by id, not by date, so the newest are not necessarily here. The absence of a run does not demonstrate that a target was never probed.

results.title: Per-probe results
results.description: Each probe's outcome. The fingerprint is a one-way hash — never an attack payload.

catalog.title: Probe catalog
catalog.description: The battery taxonomy and its framework coverage — defensive metadata only.
catalog.metadataNote: This is defensive metadata, not an exploit cabinet. The API carries no attack payload.

catalog.title: No defensive probes cataloged
catalog.description: This read-only taxonomy is populated only by probe definitions compiled into the control plane.

familyFailureChart.title: No probe family failures recorded
familyFailureChart.description: A family appears when a scored probe in the selected run fails by complying with an adversarial request or leaking a forbidden marker.

results.title: No probe outcomes recorded yet
results.description: Launch a suite against an authorized target; each probe outcome is recorded here with a one-way fingerprint, never the attack payload.

runs.title: No red-team runs launched yet
runs.description: Register and authorize an owned agent, then launch a probe suite to record its robustness scorecard.

targets.title: No red-team targets registered yet
targets.description: Register an agent from this tenant's inventory as a candidate; authorization remains a separate consent step.
